The orders page is fixed. Two stray `
` tags above the "Recent orders" heading in `site/orders.html` were pushing the table down by about 48px. I removed them, and all 28 tests now pass, including the visual comparisons for the orders page at desktop and phone size. I couldn't see which change added the tags, because the repo has only one commit. I identified them by comparing the failing screenshot with the approved one. STATUS: DONE
